test_title: RRB NTPC CBT 2 (Level-3) Official Paper (Held On: 17 June 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: What percentage of Defence Research and Development budget has been set aside for start-ups and private entities in the Union Budget 2022-23 for the financial year 2022-23?
solution:
The correct answer is __**25%.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• Defence R&D will be opened up for industry, startups and academia with **25% of the defence R&D budget earmarked.**
 
• Private industry will be encouraged to take up the design and development of military platforms and equipment.
 
• It will be in the collaboration with DRDO and other organizations through the SPV model.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

**Union Budget 2022-23**

 
• The Budget goals for FY2022-23 aim to further India's aspirations in Amrit Kaal, as it moves towards its 100th-year post-independence.
 
 
• **Focus on growth and all-inclusive welfare.**
 
• **Promoting technology-enabled development, energy transition and climate action.**
 
• **Virtuous cycle starts from private investment, crowded in by public capital investment.**
 
 
 
• The Union Budget for FY 2022-23 this year aims to strengthen the infrastructure with its focus on four priorities of:
 
 
• **PM GatiShakti**
 
• **Inclusive Development**
 
• **Productivity Enhancement & Investment, Sunrise opportunities, Energy Transition, and Climate Action**
 
• **Financing of investments**
